# Kent McGuire Law Firm

> > Oklahoma-based personal injury law firm with 30+ years of experience in accident claims, bad faith insurance, and negligence litigation.

Kent McGuire Law Firm is a full-service personal injury practice serving Oklahoma City and surrounding areas. The firm specializes in car accidents, brain injuries, bicycle accidents, dog bites, and bad faith insurance claims, with a team of experienced attorneys recognized by national legal organizations.
